title: ollama/ollama: Release v0.40.7

topic.reason: Neue KI-Modelle, Funktionen, Benchmarks (Treffer: model, qwen, llama)

summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.40.7): ## What's Changed * [pplx-decider](https://ollama.com/library/pplx-decider) is a 27B decision model from Perplexity, fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B * Continuing an OpenAI-compatible Responses conversation no longer fails when switching between models with and without thinking, or when the history contains another provider's compaction items * Fixed streaming Responses requests where client tool calls (e.g. Codex with web search) could emit before open reasoning items, producing misordered/duplicate tool call events * Requests routed to remote models are now cancelled on ollama.com when the client disconnects, instead of continuing to run * `ollama show` now reports which renderer and parser a model uses and where its chat template comes from; the API exposes the same values in new `renderer`, `parser`, and `template_source` fields * More draft models now work with speculative decoding: llama-server infers the draft type automatically instead of requiring Ollama to identify it * `ollama la
